record.title: Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and Establishment of Trust
record.title_ko: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법
record.text_en: Providers of high-impact AI must implement measures for safety and reliability, including risk management, explainability approaches where technically possible, user protection, human management and oversight, and documentation of safety/reliability measures.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 고영향 인공지능 제공자는 위험관리방안, 설명방안, 이용자 보호, 사람의 관리·감독, 안전성·신뢰성 조치의 문서화·보관 등을 포함한 조치를 이행해야 한다.
record.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Science and ICT

record.title: Bioethics and Safety Act
record.text_en: Institutions conducting human-subject or human-derived-material research must establish an Institutional Review Board. The IRB reviews ethical and scientific validity, lawful consent, participant safety, personal-information protection measures, and monitors ongoing research.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 인간대상연구 또는 인체유래물연구를 수행하는 기관은 기관생명윤리위원회를 설치해야 하며, 연구계획의 윤리적·과학적 타당성, 적법한 동의, 연구대상자 안전, 개인정보 보호대책 등을 심의한다.
record.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Health and Welfare

record.title: Medical Service Act
record.text_en: Electronic medical records may be created and retained electronically. Medical institutions must maintain facilities and equipment necessary for safe management and preservation, unauthorized detection, leakage, alteration or destruction is prohibited, and access records must be separately retained when records are added or modified.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 전자의무기록은 안전하게 관리·보존되어야 하며 정당한 사유 없는 개인정보 탐지·누출·변조·훼손이 금지되고, 추가기재·수정 시 접속기록을 별도로 보관해야 한다.
record.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Health and Welfare

record.title: Personal Information Protection Act
record.text_en: Pseudonymized information may be processed without the data subject's consent for statistics, scientific research, or public-interest archiving, and third-party provision must not include information that could be used to identify a specific person.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 통계작성, 과학적 연구, 공익적 기록보존 등을 위해 동의 없이 가명정보를 처리할 수 있으며, 제3자 제공 시 특정 개인 식별에 사용될 수 있는 정보를 포함해서는 안 된다.
record.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Personal Information Protection Commission

record.title: Personal Information Protection Act
record.text_en: Controllers processing pseudonymized information must implement technical, administrative, and physical safeguards and maintain records of pseudonymized-data processing.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 가명정보 처리자는 기술적·관리적·물리적 안전조치를 취하고 가명정보 처리 관련 기록을 작성·보관해야 한다.
record.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Personal Information Protection Commission

record.title: Personal Information Security Measures Standard
record.text_en: The standard establishes minimum technical, managerial, and physical safeguards for protecting personal information against loss, theft, leakage, forgery, alteration, or damage, and defines access-record concepts for personal-information systems.
record.retrieval_text_ko: 개인정보 보호 기술적 관리적 물리적 안전조치 접근통제 접속기록 무결성
